layout.footer: Pukalani · Community software made and hosted in Germany

gate.title: Set up your community
gate.heading: Welcome, {name}.
gate.intro: Pukalani is in early access — you need an invite code. After that we'll set up your community together in a few steps.
gate.codeHint: It's in your invitation email. Capitalisation doesn't matter.
gate.rejected: That code isn't valid (any more). Check the spelling — or ask us for a new one.
gate.noCode: No code? Tell us what you want to use Pukalani for — we invite new communities continuously.

request.title: Request early access
request.intro: Pukalani is still in early access. Leave your address — we'll get back to you with an invite code as soon as a spot opens up.
request.emailHint: The code goes to this address and is only valid for it.
request.noteLabel: What do you want to use Pukalani for?
request.noteHint: Two sentences are enough. Helps us judge whether it's a fit right now.
request.failed: That didn't work just now. Try again in a minute.
request.privacy: We store your address only to send you access — and delete it if nothing comes of it.
request.doneBody: We have your request. As soon as a spot opens up, you'll get an invite code by email.
request.doneHint: Check your spam folder too — and if the email doesn't arrive, just write to us again.

basics.title: Name and address
basics.heading: Let's start, {name}.
basics.intro: A working title is perfectly fine — you can change both later.

size.title: How many people are you bringing?
size.intro: An estimate is enough. We use it to set things up for you, not to hold you back.

category.title: What is yours about?
category.intro: Pick the closest one. It doesn't decide any features — it helps us show you relevant things.

description.title: Who are you bringing together?
description.intro: Two sentences are enough. They become the first version of your home page — editable once you're in.

goal.title: What would feel like real success in six months?
goal.intro: Pick what matters most. We use it to show you the right next steps.

vibe.title: Which mood fits?
vibe.intro: Colours and type for your community. Six starting points from our catalogue.
vibe.changeable: Later you get the full range — 26 colour worlds with eleven shades each, plus your own fonts.

summary.title: Does this look right?
summary.intro: Check your answers. One click creates your community — the trial starts at that moment.

fields.name: What should your community be called?
fields.nameHint: The name appears in the site header and in emails.
fields.addressHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. You can connect your own domain later.
fields.addressTaken: That address is already taken. Please pick another one.
fields.addressUnknown: We couldn't check just now — you can still continue.
fields.descriptionHint: Who do you bring together, and what for? Write it the way you'd tell a friend.
fields.suggestFailed: The draft didn't work. Feel free to write your own — or try again later.
fields.suggestNote: The draft comes from an AI and is just that: read it, change it, throw it away. Nothing is saved until you continue.

other.label: Something else
other.hint: Tell us in the next step.

relationships.label: Build relationships
relationships.hint: Members who show up for each other.

knowledge.label: Collect knowledge
knowledge.hint: Findable instead of lost in chat.

reach.label: Reach more of the right people
reach.hint: Publicly readable content that gets found.

summary.name: Name
summary.trialTitle: 14 days of Pro, no payment details
summary.trialBody: After that your community continues on the free plan — with smaller limits. Nothing is locked, nothing is deleted.

errors.hostTaken: That address was just taken. Go back one step and pick another one.
errors.notAllowed: That didn't work: either the invite code is no longer valid, or you already have a community in its trial.
errors.invalid: One of the answers doesn't fit. Please walk back through the steps.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't create the community just now. Try again in a minute — your answers are kept.

done.title: Your community is live
done.heading: {name} is live.
done.intro: You're the owner. The community is private — only invited members can see the content.

hints.private: Private by default: content is members-only. "Publicly readable" is a switch in the settings.
hints.trial: The trial runs for 14 days. After that the free plan applies automatically — smaller limits, nothing for you to do.
hints.settings: Name, address, colours and home page can be changed any time in your community's dashboard.

validation.slugInvalid: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
validation.slugReserved: That address is reserved. Please pick another one.
